title: Sources: Chargers, TE Njoku agree to 1-yr. deal

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Sources: Chargers, TE Njoku agree to 1-yr. deal
sources.description: After nine years with the Browns, David Njoku has agreed to terms with the Chargers on a one-year deal worth up to $8 million, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
